title: Add /api/diagnostics Endpoint for Effective Runtime Config
description:
MemorySmith's current /health endpoint returns a binary up/down check. External agents and operators need richer runtime introspection: whether the embedding provider is reachable, index build state (clean/stale/building/error), and memory-store health (file count, parse-error count). This is the 'Diagnostics API' gap identified in the June 2026 LLMWikiServer parity review.

### Motivation
Athena and external MCP clients currently call memorysmith_search to probe system state, which is wasteful and unreliable. A dedicated /api/diagnostics endpoint would let any caller confirm the system is genuinely functional before issuing a workload.

### Acceptance Criteria
- GET /api/diagnostics returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing:
  - embeddingProvider: { reachable: bool } — NO model name or endpoint URL in the base response
  - chatProvider: { reachable: bool } — NO provider name or endpoint URL in the base response
  - codeSearchIndex: { status: "clean"|"stale"|"building"|"error", indexedFileCount, lastBuildUtc }
  - memoryStore: { totalCount, parseErrorCount }
  - version: string (major.minor.patch only, no commit hash)
- Base endpoint is authorized by CanViewMemorySmith policy (same as /api/health)
- A privileged variant GET /api/diagnostics/full requires CanAdminMemorySmith policy and adds:
  - embeddingProvider.modelName, embeddingProvider.vectorDimension
  - chatProvider.name, chatProvider.latencyMs
  - memoryStore.workingCount, memoryStore.coreCount
- Neither variant is exposed unauthenticated, including in LocalDev SecurityProfile
- Response schema is documented under Data/Pages
- Rate-limit the endpoint in production SecurityProfiles (RemoteHardened minimum)

### Security Notes (raised in council review, 2026-06-01)
- The base /api/diagnostics is deliberately scoped to minimum-necessary fields to avoid leaking stack topology to any viewer-level account. Provider names and model identifiers are privileged fields that map your internal infrastructure.
- If SecurityProfile == LocalDev and the instance is 100% local, stricter gating is still recommended — habits formed here carry forward if the profile ever changes.
- Do not add a MCP tool (memorysmith_diagnostics) that bypasses this policy gating.

### Extensions to Consider
- Hook security profile into rate-limit tier automatically
- Add /api/diagnostics/full variant gated by admin role (already in acceptance criteria above)
- Expose a minimal MCP tool memorysmith_system_status that calls the base /api/diagnostics and returns only the reachable booleans and index status — never the full admin detail

### Source
Originated from external parity review (LLMWikiServer, June 2026). Memory: external-parity-observations-20260601.

comments.Body: Feature gap identified in June 2026 external parity review (LLMWikiServer). See memory external-parity-observations-20260601 for full context. The external agent noted that without this, agents must resort to memorysmith_search probes to confirm the system is live — inefficient and fragile.

comments.Author: council-security-seat
comments.Body: Council review (2026-06-01): Security seat flagged that a naive implementation returning model names and provider endpoints to any CanViewMemorySmith user would create an information-disclosure surface. Acceptance criteria updated to split base (reachable booleans + counts only) from /full (privileged detail). Rate-limiting added to RemoteHardened profile requirement. Neither variant should be unauthenticated.
